sections.content_markdown: (yl) with the last part of the name of Alkane from which a hydrogen atom was removed for formation of Alkyl Radicals. For instance, we can say Methyl ($\text{CH}_3-$) from Methane ($\text{CH}_4$), Ethyl ($\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-$) from Ethane ($\text{C}_2\text{H}_6$), Propyl ($\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-$) from Propane, Butyl ($\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-$) from Butane, Pentyl ($\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-$) from Pentane, etc.

sections.section_title: Table 11.01: Carbon numbers, names and formula of Alkanes.
sections.content_markdown:
| Carbon number of Alkane | Name of Alkane | Formula of Alkane |
| :---: | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | Methane | $\text{CH}_4$ |
| 2 | Ethane | $\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_3$ |
| 3 | Propane | $\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3$ |
| 4 | Butane | $\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3$ |
| 5 | Pentane | $\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3$ |
| 6 | Hexane | $\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3$ |
| 7 | Heptane | $\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3$ |
| 8 | Octane | $\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3$ |
| 9 | Nonane | $\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3$ |
| 10 | Decane | $\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3$ |
